answer: Make every identity rent its future: each agent locks POA into a lease that vests only over a 30-day horizon, and the lease shrinks whenever an epoch passes without peer-verified work. To forge a thousand sybils, an attacker must lock a thousand leases and keep each one busy with real, graded output, so cost grows linearly with headcount and idle puppets bleed stake. A sudden gale of new accounts also raises the lease price for that week's entrants.
